A Guide to OPVC Pipes

Pipes made from Oriented Polyvinyl Chloride (OPVC) are among the latest plastic pipe materials. During manufacture, the molecules of PVC are oriented in a specific direction to enhance their mechanical properties.

Performance Highlights of OPVC Pipes

  • A higher degree of hardness: The molecular orientation significantly improves the material’s tensile strength and impact resistance.
  • Lightweight: They are lighter than traditional PVC pipes despite their strength.
  • High Hydraulic Capacity: OPVC pipes have smooth interior surfaces that reduce friction losses, improving flow efficiency.
  • Durability: They resist external impacts and internal pressures, so they are ideal for high-stress applications.
  • Energy Conservation: Due to their lightweight design, they consume less energy during installation and reduce the emission of greenhouse gases.

India’s Most Trusted OPVC Pipe Manufacturers

1. Prayag India

Prayag India Ltd. is one of India’s leading OPVC pipe manufacturer. The company’s production facilities are advanced, ensuring high-quality products. By employing advanced molecular orientation techniques, Prayag enhances the mechanical properties of their OPVC pipes, resulting in superior durability, strength, and hydraulic performance.

These lightweight, corrosion-resistant pipes and environmentally friendly nature make them ideal for various applications, including water supply, irrigation, and industrial systems. Prayag has solidified its position as one of the top companies in India’s OPVC pipe manufacturing industry through its dedication to innovation and customer satisfaction.

2. APL Apollo

APL Apollo Pipes is one of the Indian manufacturer of O-PVC pipes. Their Ultima OPVC pipes, crafted with advanced molecular orientation technology, offer superior strength, durability, and flexibility, making them ideal for high-pressure applications like irrigation, potable water supply, and firefighting systems.

Complying with IS 16647:2017 and ISO 16422 standards, these pipes come in sizes from 90mm to 400mm with pressure ratings from PN10 to PN25, ensuring reliability across diverse applications. Known for leak-proof joints and ease of installation, Ultima O-PVC pipes are a trusted solution for efficient water transportation.

3.Chemfab Alkalis Limited

A manufacturer of OPVC pipes in India, Chemfab Alkalis Limited (CCAL) operates an advanced facility in Andhra Pradesh. Molecular orientation technology, which offers superior strength, flexibility, and durability, benefits high-pressure applications such as irrigation and potable water supply.

CCAL’s pipes, which meet IS 16647:2017, are available in various sizes and pressure classes. Regarding reliable water conveyance solutions, CCAL stands out for its sustainability, corrosion resistance, and ease of installation.

4. Ori-Plast

An Indian manufacturer of Polyvinyl Chloride-O (Oriented Polyvinyl Chloride) pipes, Ori-Plast offers a range of high-quality piping solutions. Using advanced molecular orientation technology, their OPVC pipes enhance standard PVC’s mechanical properties. The process produces more substantial, durable, and flexible pipes, ideal for high-pressure water applications like irrigation, potable water supply, and industrial applications.

The OPVC pipes manufactured by Ori-Plast have nominal diameters ranging from 90mm to 400mm and pressure ratings of PN16 and PN25 bars. They are high quality and reliable.

5. Delta Irrigation LLP

Founded in 2005, Delta Irrigation LLP is also India’s OPVC (Oriented Polyvinyl Chloride) pipes manufacturer. Their advanced manufacturing techniques enhance PVC’s mechanical properties, producing more robust, durable, and flexible pipes. Among their many applications are irrigation, potable water supply, and industrial systems requiring high-pressure water.

Delta Irrigation’s OPVC pipes are available in diameters ranging from 110mm to 630mm, with pressure ratings of 12.5kg, 16kg, 20kg, and 25kg. These pipes comply with BIS 16647:2017 and ISO 16642:2014 standards, ensuring high quality and reliability.

Applications of Prayag O-PVC Pipes

  1. Potable Water Supply: Drinking water can be safely transported in them as they are strong, corrosion-resistant, and safe.
  2. Irrigation Systems: This irrigation method ensures efficient water distribution for crops in agricultural irrigation.
  3. Industrial Fluid Transport: Suitable for carrying chemicals, industrial fluids, and other non-corrosive substances.
  4. Firefighting Systems: Used in high-pressure firefighting pipelines due to their strength and durability.
  5. Sewage and Wastewater Management: Their leak-proof and impact-resistant properties make them perfect for drainage and wastewater systems.
  6. Infrastructure Development: Construction materials used in plumbing, public utility pipelines, and underground water systems are essential.
  7. Municipal Water Distribution: Hydraulic efficiency makes them popular for large-scale water distribution networks.
  8. Mining Operations: They are used for dewatering and water supply, where durability and pressure resistance are critical.
  9. Desalination and Water Treatment Plants: Applicable in desalination plants and water purification systems for transporting treated water.
  10. Stormwater Drainage: Effective for managing rainwater and stormwater in urban drainage systems.

Standards and Certifications of Prayag OPVC Pipes

Prayag India Ltd. ensures its OPVC pipes’ highest standards and certifications as part of its commitment to quality and performance. Their products meet both national and international benchmarks to guarantee reliability and efficiency. OPVC pipes are typically certified, graded, or rated by the following standards:

  1. ISO Certification: ISO certification ensures compliance with quality management systems throughout manufacturing.
  2. BIS Compliance: Prayag’s OPVC pipes comply with Indian piping standards established by the Bureau of Indian Standards.
  3. Environmental Standards: The pipes are constructed with environmentally friendly materials, reducing the environmental impact, perhaps by ISO 14001.
  4. Hydraulic Efficiency Standards: Prayag’s pipes follow minimum friction and high flow capacity standards to ensure optimal hydraulic performance.
  5. Pressure and Durability Testing: Each OPVC pipe is tested for high pressure and impact resistance to meet industry standards.
  6. Potable Water Certification: Prayag produces OPVC pipes that are certified safe for use in potable water.

Prayag: Revolutionizing the O-PVC Pipe Industry in India

OPVC pipes represent a remarkable advancement in the piping industry, combining strength, durability, and efficiency with environmental sustainability. Among the top manufacturers in India, Prayag India Ltd. has emerged as a leader, setting benchmarks in quality and performance through advanced molecular orientation techniques. Their OPVC pipes are designed to meet the diverse needs of applications such as potable water supply, irrigation, industrial fluid transport, and infrastructure development.

Prayag’s commitment to innovation and adherence to the highest standards, including ISO and BIS certifications, underscore their focus on delivering reliable, high-quality solutions. These pipes are lightweight, corrosion-resistant, and environmentally friendly, aligning with modern demands for sustainable infrastructure. Prayag ensures its OPVC pipes perform optimally even in high-stress applications with products that meet rigorous hydraulic efficiency and pressure resistance standards.

Other top manufacturers, such as APL Apollo, Chemfab Alkalis, Ori-Plast, and Delta Irrigation LLP, contribute significantly to the industry. These companies offer high-quality O-PVC pipes tailored for various sectors. Collectively, these companies drive the adoption of O-PVC technology, fostering sustainability and efficiency across critical industries.

OPVC pipes’ versatility and durability make them an excellent choice for municipal water distribution, firefighting systems, and industrial applications. India and beyond benefit from these pipes’ superior features and extensive applications. Choosing OPVC pipes from trusted manufacturers like Prayag ensures a long-term, cost-effective, and eco-friendly solution for water conveyance and infrastructure needs.
